entries.title: John 15:1
segments: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

entries.title: John 15:2
segments: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.

entries.title: John 15:3
segments: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.

entries.title: John 15:4
segments: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.

entries.title: John 15:5
segments: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.

entries.title: John 15:6
segments: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

entries.title: John 15:7
segments: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

entries.title: John 15:8
segments: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and [so] shall ye be my disciples.

entries.title: John 15:9
segments: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.

entries.title: John 15:10
segments: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

entries.title: John 15:11
segments: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and [that] your joy may be made full.

entries.title: John 15:12
segments: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.

entries.title: John 15:13
segments: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

entries.title: John 15:14
segments: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.

entries.title: John 15:15
segments: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father, I have made known unto you.

entries.title: John 15:16
segments: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and [that] your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

entries.title: John 15:17
segments: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.

entries.title: John 15:18
segments: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before [it hated] you.

entries.title: John 15:19
segments: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

entries.title: John 15:20
segments: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

entries.title: John 15:21
segments: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

entries.title: John 15:22
segments: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.

entries.title: John 15:23
segments: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

entries.title: John 15:24
segments: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

entries.title: John 15:25
segments: But [this cometh to pass], that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

entries.title: John 15:26
segments: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, [even] the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:

entries.title: John 15:27
segments: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
